module: Post-processing of two miscellaneous jbeam sections. (1) Engine section: builds engine.waterDamage.nodes by concatenating the node lists coming from the group links _group_nodes and _engineGroup_nodes of waterDamage (nodes whose drowning damages the engine). (2) Soundscape section: transforms the list of entries into a dictionary indexed by their name field. Called by the loader after the group link resolution.
notes: If vehicle.engine exists but without waterDamage, an empty waterDamage table is created; nodes becomes a list (possibly empty).
For soundscape, two entries with the same name overwrite each other (the last iterated wins); an entry without name is stored under the nil key, which raises a Lua error.

process.desc: Applies the two post-processings (engine.waterDamage.nodes and soundscape) in place on the vehicle data.
